1 new button for passive income. Each button will have a knowledge level need before it can be used but even the first level will finish the game on its own.

notes.title: Lore Drop
notes.content: The game is set in a magical world known as The World, and you are attending The Main College located inside The Important Town.  Watch out, The Main College is hiring dust mite soldiers to stop you from your clicking. Will you stand up against them or ignore them and keep clicking?
